blocks.rationale: Jointly revise the installed exception producer and its terminal consequence. The producer now reads one complete disclosure-permission record, including the CCPDT agreement's service-related exception, so an absent Representatives clause no longer leaves required premises unresolved. The terminal preserves the distinction between internal employees and third parties: an applicable express permission entails the query, a general third-party prohibition contradicts an uncovered third-party query, and that prohibition alone does not decide an employee query. This fixes the trigger's nda-5 failure while preserving the two history parents' employee and professional-advisor outcomes.

skill.intent: Classify a Receiving Party disclosure-permission query using an expressly applicable disclosure permission and the current agreement's general third-party nondisclosure rule without extending a third-party prohibition to unaddressed internal employees.

outputs.description: Native ContractNLI classification of the disclosure-permission statement.
